g.text: All presented continual methods, including the missing families
Two-epoch shared protocol; feature representations and intrinsic training differ as labeled. MIST reconstructed; VFDT uses River.
Memory includes PCA, shared frozen teachers, covariance and caches. Optimizers, Python/RNG overhead and peak working RAM excluded.
